cases.note: Evaluator file gate: StardewMods/ exists, required files present, no symlinks.

cases.id: case:setup: build a Junimo hut with a connected chest
cases.note: Builds the hut through Farm.buildStructure, places the side chest, seeds the hut chest with parsnip seeds, fertilizer and diamonds. Asserts only fixture facts.

cases.id: case:sentinel: fertilizer is moved out of the hut per config
cases.note: P in the unchanged starter. With fertilizer=MoveIntoChests and gems=MoveIntoChests, both the fertilizer (O)368 and the diamond (O)72 must reach the side chest.

cases.id: case:seeds stay in the hut when the seed behavior is Ignore
cases.note: With seeds=Ignore while fertilizer=MoveIntoChests: seeds (O)472 still in the hut and none in the side chest, 240 ticks after the sentinel observed the pipeline running.

clauses.anchor: Problem, paragraph 2, sentence 2: "I set seeds to Ignore ... but Automate still moves them out into my chests"
clauses.note: The reported configuration is reproduced exactly by tests/mod-config.json.

clauses.anchor: Task, sentence 1 (first half): "Make the Junimo hut seed behavior follow its own config option"
clauses.note: Only one value of the seed option (Ignore) under one fertilizer value (MoveIntoChests) is exercised in a single boot. The opposite direction (seeds=MoveIntoChests while fertilizer=Ignore, seeds must move), MoveIntoHut and AutoDetect are never run, so hard-coding seedBehavior = Ignore, or reading any other option that happens to be Ignore, scores 3/3.

clauses.anchor: Task, sentence 1 (second half): "without changing how the other item types are handled"
clauses.note: Fertilizer and gems under MoveIntoChests only; their Ignore/MoveIntoHut/AutoDetect handling is not exercised. Discoverable in the starter: Automate/Framework/Models/ModConfig.cs:30-40 documents the three options and Framework/Machines/Buildings/JunimoHutMachine.cs applies them per category.

clauses.anchor: Problem, paragraph 2, last sentence: "The gem option works exactly as advertised"
clauses.note: Diamond moved under gems=MoveIntoChests. Note AutoDetect for gems means Ignore, so the explicit MoveIntoChests in mod-config.json is what makes this observable.

clauses.anchor: Notes, bullet 3: "Do not modify anything under `/tests`"
clauses.note: Enforced by construction (pack tests are bind-mounted read-only), not by a case.

known_issues: Single-configuration suite: tests/mod-config.json fixes seeds=Ignore, fertilizer=MoveIntoChests, gems=MoveIntoChests and tests/SuiteJunimoHut.cs:73-83 only asserts that seeds stay. No case distinguishes 'reads JunimoHutBehaviorForSeeds' from 'never moves seeds'. Task-1 is therefore weak; results on this task measure the reported symptom, not the general contract.

SuiteJunimoHut.cs:73-83 is a negative assertion after a fixed 240-tick sleep. It is only meaningful because the preceding sentinel proved the hut pipeline ran; if the sentinel fails (hut never outputs anything), the target case still passes. A submission that breaks the whole Junimo hut machine therefore scores target=P, preserved=F, which is exactly the compat-negative shape; do not read the target case in isolation.

Wait predicate SuiteJunimoHut.cs:61-65 guards this._sideChest with 'is not null' and uses null-conditional item access; it cannot throw. The harness fix in private/harbor/harness/GcbHarness/Framework/SuiteRunner.cs:80-96 does not change any verdict here. The prepared evaluator image recorded in runtimeIdentity (sha256:49358248b2a4...) still bakes the pre-fix SuiteRunner at /opt/gcb/harness.

The exam's player report names the masking option ('if I also set the fertilizer option to Ignore, the seeds stay put'), which localizes the defect to one line; see private/harbor/DEBUG-HARDENING.md section 1.
